news.headline: Tenax expects Phase 3 LEVEL trial data in August 2026
Tenax Therapeutics reports Q2 net loss $17.8M, cash $118.0M; LEVEL Phase 3 topline due Aug 2026
Tenax Therapeutics (TENX) CEO Giordano reports 1.69M-share, 4.32% stake
Tenax Therapeutics Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Corporate Update
news.summary: Tenax reported a Q2 2026 net loss of $17.8 million and cash/cash equivalents of $118.0 million as of June 30, 2026, boosted by $13.4 million from warrant exercises. The company reaffirmed it expects topline data from the Phase 3 LEVEL trial of TNX-103 (oral levosimendan) in August 2026.

news.headline: BlackRock reports 6.4% stake in Tenax Therapeutics (TENX)
news.summary: BlackRock disclosed a passive 6.4% equity stake in Tenax Therapeutics in a new Schedule 13G/A filing, adding to a growing list of institutional holders positioning ahead of the Phase 3 LEVEL data readout.

news.headline: Evercore ISI initiates Tenax Therapeutics stock coverage with outperform rating
news.summary: Evercore ISI began coverage of TENX with an Outperform rating and a $39 price target, assigning roughly a 50% probability of success to the Phase 3 LEVEL trial versus the 20-25% odds it says are priced into the stock. The firm sees 250% to 10x upside on positive data against significant downside if the trial fails.

news.headline: Tenax Therapeutics CEO exercises stock options, acquires 8,719 shares
news.summary: CEO Christopher Thomas Giordano exercised stock options on July 13, 2026 to acquire 8,719 common shares (8,500 at $5.94 and 219 at $3.549 per share), per an SEC Form 4 filing.

news.headline: Tenax Therapeutics Announces Late-Breaking Presentation of LEVEL Clinical Trial Data at ESC Congress 2026
news.summary: Tenax confirmed that topline Phase 3 LEVEL trial results for TNX-103 (oral levosimendan) in PH-HFpEF will be unveiled in a Late-Breaking Clinical Science session at the ESC Congress 2026 in Munich (August 28-31), presented by Prof. Sanjiv Shah of Northwestern University. This pins the long-awaited data readout to a specific late-August window.

news.headline: Tenax and Orion secure long-term levosimendan supply deal, extend license through 2035
news.summary: Orion Corporation exercised its option to become the primary long-term manufacturer/supplier of oral levosimendan under a new five-year Supply Agreement with automatic renewals, and the parties amended their 2013 License Agreement to extend the deadline for U.S. regulatory approval to December 31, 2035.

news.headline: Guggenheim raises Tenax Therapeutics price target to $40, lifts trial success odds to 80%
news.summary: Guggenheim maintained its Buy rating on TENX and raised its price target to $40 from $34, increasing its probability-of-success estimate for the Phase 3 LEVEL trial to 80% from 75%. The firm noted Tenax is the only company running a Phase 3 trial in PH-HFpEF, a condition with no approved treatments.

catalysts.label: LEVEL Phase 3 topline data presented at ESC Congress 2026
catalysts.detail: A Late-Breaking Clinical Science session in Munich will present full topline results of the Phase 3 LEVEL trial of oral levosimendan (TNX-103) in PH-HFpEF, presented by Prof. Sanjiv Shah; this is the binary event the stock is currently pricing.

catalysts.label: Database lock and 6MWD primary endpoint readout
catalysts.detail: Company guidance calls for database lock and statistical analysis on the primary 6-minute walk distance endpoint ahead of the ESC presentation; a December 2025 blinded sample-size re-estimation confirmed the trial is powered above 90% to detect a 25-meter 6MWD change.

catalysts.label: LEVEL-2 global trial enrollment completion
catalysts.detail: The global, ex-US LEVEL-2 registrational Phase 3 trial of oral levosimendan in PH-HFpEF, initiated in December 2025, is ongoing, with enrollment completion targeted by the end of 2027 ahead of a potential NDA filing.

catalysts.label: Potential NDA filing for TNX-103
catalysts.detail: Should the Phase 3 LEVEL trial hit its primary endpoint (25-meter change in 6-minute walk distance), investors and analysts widely expect Tenax to move toward an NDA submission for TNX-103; this has not been formally guided by the company and remains contingent on the August data.

pulse: Tenax Therapeutics reported Q2 2026 results on July 31 (net loss $17.8M, cash $118.0M boosted by warrant exercises), reaffirming that topline data from its make-or-break Phase 3 LEVEL trial of oral levosimendan in PH-HFpEF remains on track for August 2026, with full results set for a late-breaking ESC Congress presentation on August 29 in Munich. Sell-side sentiment has turned increasingly bullish into the catalyst -- Evercore ISI initiated at Outperform, Guggenheim lifted its probability-of-success estimate to 80%, and BlackRock disclosed a fresh 6.4% stake -- while a long-term Orion supply agreement (license extended to 2035) adds further confidence, even as some analysts flag binary-outcome caution and dilution risk from an active shelf registration. With cash now guided into Q1 2028, TENX remains essentially a leveraged bet on the imminent August data.
